messages:
Maya: Quick copy pass for the website landing pages (Hosted API / Dedicated / Private). Trying to consolidate messaging for the launch posts + webinar CTA + benchmark links. Draft below — please react/take ownership where needed.

Proposed hero lines (short, benefit-first):
- Hosted API: 'Start answering faster — production-grade text & chat with a single API.'
- Dedicated: 'Reserved GPU capacity for predictable throughput and enterprise SLAs.'
- Private: 'Run inference behind your VPC — full control, compliance-ready.'

Subheads / supporting bullets (one-liners):
- Hosted: 'Pay-as-you-go, instant scale, streaming & function calls.'
- Dedicated: 'Guaranteed latency SLOs, burst capacity, private model pins.'
- Private: 'Customer-managed networking, KMS/HSM integrations, audit trails.'

Primary CTAs: 'Get started' (hosted), 'Talk to sales' (dedicated), 'Request private demo' (private).

Webinar CTA: 'Join our launch webinar: Behind the scenes of inference economics — Apr 29, 11am PT' with a signup form that routes leads to the appropriate sales path.

Lead routing (basic idea):
```
utm_source=web&utm_campaign=launch2026&mode=hosted|dedicated|private
route -> marketing->sales_queue_{mode} (dedicated gets AE flag)
form fields: name,email,company,mode,expected_qps
```

Benchmark note: add a short line on the page linking to 'benchmarks' with 99th pct latency and typical token cost numbers (no absolute claims, phrase as 'typical' / 'verified by Redwood').

Alex: Love this layout. Two quick asks: 1) Make the Hosted hero mention streaming (that's a big win for devs). 2) For Dedicated, we should call out 'SLA-backed 99.9% uptime' only if legal has signed off — otherwise use 'SLA options available'.

Alex: For lead routing, suggest we add a hidden field 'commit_level' if they come from Dedicated pricing page (helps PS to prioritize). Also recommend mapping to SFDC lead_owner by region (EMEA/APAC/NAM).

Jordan: Nice. For the benchmark text — can we add a small hero stat like '~50ms median token latency on common workloads (verified)'? If that feels risky, change to 'low-latency inference profiles'. Also, webinar blurb should say what attendees will learn: batching/caching, cost tricks, rollout strategies.

Sam: Split-test note: headline A = benefit-first (you wrote that), headline B = job-to-be-done ('Ship chat features with predictable latency & cost'). Run 2-week test, 50/50. Also suggest gating the webinar signup after a micro-form for higher quality leads (email+company only), then expand on next page.

Emily: Ping on analytics — we'll need event names and UTM plan. Proposed events: page_view_landing_{mode}, click_cta_get_started, click_cta_request_demo, webinar_signup. I'll add GA4 + segment track calls. Also, do we have final date for the webinar? Need to confirm for the hero.

Maya: Thanks — updated copy incorporating feedback: added 'streaming' to Hosted hero, replaced 'SLA-backed 99.9%' with 'SLA options available' for now, and swapped in the webinar 'what you'll learn' bullets. Draft doc here: https://docs.redwood.ai/launch/web-copy-pass (please comment).

Maya: Next steps: Alex to own lead routing & SFDC mapping, Sam to set up A/B in Optimizely, Emily to add analytics events, Jordan to finalize benchmark phrasing with research, I'll iterate final copy and push to staging by EOD Thurs.

Alex: I can take routing. Quick Q: for Dedicated leads, is there a minimum commit flag? If yes, we should add that to the form dropdown so sales can pre-qual.

Sam: I'll spin up the test and grab the mailchimp/webinar form integration. Recommend we use hidden field 'mode' to keep routing simple.

Emily: Confirming webinar date — Apr 29 is good for comms calendar. I'll add GA4 events and chart webinar conversions on the dashboard.

marcom-bot: Reminder — final copy due by EOD Thursday for staging push. :bell:

Maya: Awesome. If nobody objects, I'll push copy updates tomorrow and leave comments on the doc for A/B variants and benchmark copy. :rocket:
